relationships.subject: UVB
relationships.evidence_quote: UVB radiation significantly increased TRPV1 protein expression in UVB-irradiated mice skin

relationships.subject: radiofrequency irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 expression was significantly lower in RF-irradiated UVB-exposed mice skin (UVB/RF group) than in the UVB group

relationships.subject: radiofrequency irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: The Camkii mRNA expression level in mice skin was significantly higher in the UVB group than in the control group; this effect was most prominent at 100 and 150 ms of RF irradiation and was significantly decreased by RF irradiation

relationships.subject: radiofrequency irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: The increased Cgrp, Pacap, and Vip expressions were significantly decreased by RF irradiation

relationships.subject: radiofrequency irradiation
relationships.evidence_quote: The increased CD163 expression by UVB exposure in mice skin was significantly decreased by RF irradiation

key_findings: RF irradiation reduced UVB- or heat-induced TRPV1, CaMKII, PKC and neuropeptide (CGRP, PACAP, VIP) expression in mouse skin and F11 cells
RF irradiation reduced macrophage activation and burning sensation in rosacea
